grammar.title: I like / I don't like
grammar.explain_en: We use 'I like' to say what food or drink we enjoy. We use 'I don't like' to say what we do not enjoy.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'I like' để nói về món ăn hoặc thức uống chúng ta yêu thích. Chúng ta dùng 'I don't like' để nói về những gì chúng ta không thích.

grammar.title: Do you like...?
grammar.explain_en: We use 'Do you like...?' to ask someone about their food or drink preferences. The answers are 'Yes, I do.' or 'No, I don't.'
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'Do you like...?' để hỏi ai đó về sở thích món ăn hoặc thức uống của họ. Câu trả lời là 'Yes, I do.' hoặc 'No, I don't.'
examples: Do you like fish? Yes, I do.
Do you like carrots? No, I don't.
Do you like yogurt? Yes, I do.

grammar.title: I want...
grammar.explain_en: We use 'I want' to ask for food or drink politely. It means you wish to have something.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'I want' để yêu cầu món ăn hoặc thức uống một cách lịch sự. Nó có nghĩa là bạn muốn có thứ gì đó.

grammar.title: It is healthy / It is delicious
grammar.explain_en: We use 'It is healthy' to say food is good for our body. We use 'It is delicious' to say food tastes good.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'It is healthy' để nói món ăn tốt cho cơ thể. Chúng ta dùng 'It is delicious' để nói món ăn có vị ngon.
examples: Milk is healthy. It helps me grow.

readings.title: OUR HEALTHY DINNER
readings.text: Hello, my name is Minh. I live with my family. My family likes healthy food. For dinner, my mom cooks many delicious dishes. We have rice. Rice gives us energy. We have chicken. Chicken is good for our muscles. We have fresh salad. The salad has carrots and tomatoes. Carrots are good for our eyes. Tomatoes are good for our skin. My dad says, "Eat your vegetables!" We drink water with our dinner. Sometimes, we have a small orange after dinner. Oranges have Vitamin C. They help us stay healthy. I love my family's healthy dinners. They make us strong and happy every day.
readings.image_prompt: A Vietnamese family (Minh, his mom, and dad) happily eating a healthy dinner together at a table. On the table, there is rice, cooked chicken, a bowl of salad with carrots and tomatoes, and glasses of water.

classroom_game.name: Healthy Food Guessing Game
steps_en: 1. Student A thinks of a healthy food from the unit.
3. Student A answers 'Yes, I do.' or 'No, I don't.'.
4. Student B tries to guess the food. If correct, they swap roles. If not, Student B asks another question.
steps_vi: 1. Học sinh A nghĩ về một món ăn lành mạnh trong bài học.
2. Học sinh B hỏi 'Bạn có thích (món ăn) không?'.
3. Học sinh A trả lời 'Có, tôi có.' hoặc 'Không, tôi không.'.
4. Học sinh B cố gắng đoán món ăn. Nếu đúng, đổi vai. Nếu không, Học sinh B hỏi câu khác.

Corrected juice emoji from 🥤 (soda) to 🧃 (juice box).
Updated IPA for chicken, juice, cheese, soup, and eat to use standard American English symbols.
Fixed fun fact: Bananas grow on giant herbs, not trees; replaced with the fact about growing towards the sun.
Added a new fun fact about apples floating because they contain air.

Refined Vietnamese translations to be more natural (e.g., 'tốt cho sức khỏe' instead of 'lành mạnh' in certain contexts).
